_README: Denylist for check_no_external_sources.py — blocks readable inspiration/harvest/comparison source names from re-entering the tracked tree. See rule source-confidentiality + the 2026-06-13 source-confidentiality sweep. Recommending an integrated tool is allowed; recording that we copied/derived/were-inspired-by an external source is not. To intentionally retain a source link, encrypt it via src/scripts/_lib/link_crypto.py.
_deny_digests_README: DORMANT (road-to-source-silence Phase 1.1). HMAC-SHA256 digests of the deny set, derived from the gitignored private master by src/scripts/build_source_digests.ts. It is EMPTY on purpose: the plaintext `deny` array above stays in force and is not deleted. Provisioning the CI secret SOURCE_DENY_KEY, generating production digests, removing the plaintext array and switching CI to strict mode are ONE ATOMIC MAINTAINER CHANGE (AI council 2026-08-28, blocker `where-the-key-lives`, 2/2) — splitting them leaves the gate either failing every run for want of a key or silently degraded to warn mode, which is the failure this whole programme exists to remove. Recipe: docs/maintainers/source-deny-digests.md

skip_reason.vendored_cluster: design-intelligence/corpus-grounding/design-tokens/react-shadcn-ui/tailwind-engineer + cost/*.mjs ship vendored Apache/MIT code; their upstream attribution is license-required and must NOT be stripped (ADR-061). CREDITS.md is the repo-level attribution file FOR that same cluster — it names the upstreams because the licenses require it, which is the one case source-confidentiality explicitly exempts. It was missing here, so the gate flagged the very attribution the rule mandates.
skip_reason.recommendation_docs: mcp.md, mcp-registries.md, DISTRIBUTION_CHECKLIST.md, ADR-086, marketing-copy.yml reference registries (Smithery/Glama) as recommendations/distribution targets — allowed.
skip_reason.generated_bundles: content.json* bundle the vendored-cluster skill bodies above.
skip_reason.self: the linter + its denylist + the source-confidentiality rule necessarily contain the deny tokens as data.
skip_reason.provenance_ledger: provenance/borrows.jsonl and the docs/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md it generates are the license-attribution surfaces for CODE borrows, and code-provenance REQUIRES the upstream name in them: the ledger's `source_url` is a mandatory field (provenance/README.md), and lint_provenance fails when the notices file drifts from it. That is the same license-required-attribution case source-confidentiality already exempts for the vendored cluster and CREDITS.md — the rule forbids derivation-attribution, not the notice a license obliges. The collision only surfaced on 2026-08-13 because the ledger had been empty until its first record; before that there was no name to flag. Scope is deliberately these two paths and not `provenance/*`: the harvest ledger next door governs KNOWLEDGE claims, where anonymisation is the rule and no license compels a name.
skip_reason._dead_entries_removed_2026_08_28: road-to-source-silence Phase 2.3, first drawdown. Three skip_paths named files that no longer exist and were therefore exempting nothing: src/scripts/check_no_external_sources.py and src/scripts/validate_safe_paths.py (both retired in the ADR-200 Python teardown) and internal/workers/mcp/content.json.gz (a .gz, which the extension skip-list already covers). The roadmap's measurement named ONE dead entry; re-checked at execution there were three. The `validate_safe_paths` reason key went with its path. Removing a dead exemption is pure shrink -- it cannot loosen the gate, and check_suppression_hygiene forbids growth in the other direction.
skip_reason._entries_removed_2026_08_29: road-to-source-silence Phases 2.1/2.3/3.4 drew skip_paths from 32 to 22. TEN entries went, and the arithmetic is stated so it can be checked: three DEAD (suppressed zero hits, measured per entry by removal and re-scan), five archived roadmaps plus ONE roadmap-asset file REDACTED in place under ADR-250 (dated markers, mechanical word-diff audit, 0 unexplained changes) = six, one comment rephrased generically, and the review-snapshot diff.patch carve-out replaced by earned per-finding deduplication in _lib/source_snapshot_dedup.ts. 3 + 6 + 1 + 1 = 10, and 32 - 10 = 22. An earlier version of this note said "Eleven entries went" by counting the roadmap-asset file separately from the five archived roadmaps AND in the six; the published ledger was right and this sentence was wrong. Full 32-entry ledger with per-entry suppressed-hit counts and dispositions: agents/evidence/reports/source-skip-paths-ledger.md.
